name: joplin-server
title: Joplin Server
description: Sync server for the Joplin note apps on desktop and phone, with note sharing between its users and publishing a note as a web page. After deploying, sign in as admin@localhost with the password admin, change both right away, then pick Joplin Server as the sync target in each app and give it this address.

variables.name: PORT_JOPLIN_SERVER
variables.label: Host Port
variables.description: Port to expose Joplin Server on

variables.name: JOPLIN_BASE_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address the apps sync with, like https://joplin.example.com. It must be the one really used: the server turns away requests made under another address. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above

variables.name: JOPLIN_DB_PASSWORD
variables.label: Database password
variables.description: Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: the Joplin apps sign in directly to sync (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
